smartmousertcsave.doc: Enable saving of smart mouse RTC data when changed.

soundarg.doc: Specify initialization parameters for sound driver

soundbufsize.doc: Set sound buffer size to <value> msec

soundfragsize.doc: Set sound fragment size (0: very small, 1: small, 2: medium, 3: large, 4: very large)

soundoutput.doc: Sound output mode: (0: system decides mono/stereo, 1: always mono, 2: always stereo)

soundrate.doc: Set sound sample rate to <value> Hz

soundrecarg.doc: Specify initialization parameters for recording sound driver

soundwarpmode.doc: Specify how to handle sound emulation in warp mode: (0: do not emulate the sound chips, 1: keep emulating the sound chips)

values.0: do not emulate the sound chips

speed.doc: Limit emulation speed to specified value

symkeymap.doc: Specify name of symbolic keymap file

tapebasicload.doc: On autostart from tape, load to BASIC start (without ',1')

tapeport1device.doc: Set Tapeport 0 device (0: None, 1: Datasette, 2: Tape RTC (PCF8583), 4: Sense dongle)

tfe.doc: Enable the Ethernet Cartridge in TFE ("The Final Ethernet") compatible mode and set default I/O address

trapdevice1.doc: Enable general mechanisms for fast disk/tape emulation

trapdevice10.doc: Enable general mechanisms for fast disk/tape emulation

trapdevice11.doc: Enable general mechanisms for fast disk/tape emulation

trapdevice2.doc: Enable general mechanisms for fast disk/tape emulation

trapdevice4.doc: Enable general mechanisms for fast disk/tape emulation

trapdevice5.doc: Enable general mechanisms for fast disk/tape emulation

trapdevice6.doc: Enable general mechanisms for fast disk/tape emulation

trapdevice7.doc: Enable general mechanisms for fast disk/tape emulation

trapdevice8.doc: Enable general mechanisms for fast disk/tape emulation

trapdevice9.doc: Enable general mechanisms for fast disk/tape emulation

umwriteback.doc: Enable UltiMem write back to ROM file

userportdevice.doc: Set userport device (0: None, 1: Userport printer, 2: Userport RS232/Modem, 3: CGA userport joy adapter, 4: PET userport joy adapter, 6: OEM userport joy adapter, 11: WheelOfJoy userport joy adapter, 12: Userport DAC, 16: Userport RTC (RTC58321A), 17: Userport RTC (DS1307), 18: Userport Petscii SNES pad, 22: Userport I/O Simulation, 23: Userport WiC64, 24: Joystick Adapter (Spaceballs), 25: Userport Stupid Pet Tricks joystick adapter)

values.25: Userport Stupid Pet Tricks joystick adapter

userportrtc58321asave.doc: Enable saving of the Userport RTC (58321a) data when changed.

userportrtcds1307save.doc: Enable saving of the Userport RTC (DS1307) data when changed.

version.doc: Show the program name and version

VICaspectmode.doc: Set aspect ratio mode (0 = off, 1 = custom, 2 = true)

VICborders.doc: Set border display mode (0: normal, 1: full, 2: debug, 3: none)

VICbrightness.doc: Set brightness of internal calculated palette

VICcontrast.doc: Set contrast of internal calculated palette

VICcrtblur.doc: Amount of horizontal blur for the CRT emulation.

VICcrtdelaylinetype.doc: Set type of delay line used in the CRT (0: normal, 1: U only (1084 style)).

VICcrtscanlineshade.doc: Amount of scan line shading for the CRT emulation

VICfilter.doc: Select rendering filter: (0: none, 1: CRT emulation, 2: scale2x)

VICgamma.doc: Set gamma of internal calculated palette

VICglfilter.doc: Set OpenGL filtering mode (0 = nearest, 1 = linear, 2 = bicubic)

VICoddlinesoffset.doc: Set phase offset for color carrier in odd lines

VICoddlinesphase.doc: Set phase for color carrier in odd lines

VICpalette.doc: Specify name of file of external palette

VICsaturation.doc: Set saturation of internal calculated palette

VICtint.doc: Set tint of internal calculated palette

VICvsync.doc: Enable vsync to prevent screen tearing

wic64timezone.doc: Specify default timezone index, e.g. 2: European Central Time

wic64tracelevel.doc: Set WiC64 tracing level (0: off, 1: cmd-level, >2: debug-level), implicitly turns on/off WiC64 tracing
